{{Quote|Welcome to the Tusk. The specials of the day include fried Mon Cal seasquid, boiled babasta beast, and the loser of the next fight&hellip;|An announcement to the patrons of the Broken Tusk|<ref name="Wretched" />}}
'''Fried Mon Cal seasquid''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] that was made of [[Squid/Legends|squid]].<ref name="Wretched" /> It shared its name with the "Mon Cals" or the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], which was situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a number of types of [[Ocean/Legends|marine]] squid.<ref name="Glove">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref><ref name="Legacy33">[[Legacy (2006) 33|''Legacy'' (2006) 33]]</ref> At one point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], fried Mon Cal seasquid was announced as one of the special dishes of the [[Local day/Legends|day]] at [[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|the Broken Tusk]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]] of the Outer Rim's [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]] and that the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Cohden K'Reye]] did not hold in high esteem for its food.<ref name="Wretched" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fried Mon Cal seasquid was mentioned in ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a [[1997]] sourcebook authored by [[Paul Danner]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Wretched" />
